title: Creamy Vegan White Bean Chili
description: Hearty, rich, and creamy white bean chili made with 10 ingredients. Tastes even better the next day, making it ideal for meal prep.

rawText:
CAPTION (as written by the author -- trust these amounts):
Vegan white bean chili - hearty rich and creamy and only requires 10 ingredients to make (excluding spices) all from @metroontario - I used Metro’s My Health, My Choices program to easily source ingredients with vegan attributes for this tasty dish. So simple to make and even tastes better the next day - so it’s also perfect for meal prep! RECIPE in caption👇🏼
 •
Creamy vegan white bean chili 
 •
Serves: 4 
Prep Time: 10 min 
Cook Time: 30 min 
 •
Ingredients 
	•	3 tablespoons olive oil
	•	1 large onion, peeled and diced 
	•	2 large ribs celery, diced
	•	1 jalapeño, seeded and diced
	•	4 cloves garlic, peeled and minced
	•	½ teaspoon ground cumin
	•	½ teaspoon dried oregano
	•	½ teaspoon dried coriander
	•	1/2 teaspoon Chile powder 
	•	Salt and pepper to taste 
	•	1 (4-ounce) can diced green chiles
	•	2 (19-ounce) cans white beans, divided 
	•	4 cups vegetable broth, (less one cup if you want chili thicker) 
	•	1 cup corn, fresh or frozen 
	•	1/4-1/2 cup plant based heavy cream (almond or coconut) 
•
For serving (optional): 
Diced avocado , Chopped cilantro, Sliced jalapeno, Tortilla chips, Lime wedges 
•

SPOKEN TRANSCRIPT (what they say in the video -- the method is usually here, and often includes steps the caption omits):
This creamy veggie white bean chilies easy to make with only 10 ingredients all from the Toronto. Let's get started. Peer a half of your beans in the liquid for a richer, creamier soup. Then chop all your veggies and saute them in olive oil in season with salt and pepper to taste. Add your spices, green chilies, the beans and puree along with the vegetable broth. Simmer 15 minutes then add the cream and corn and simmer one to two minutes more. Load your chili up with all the fresh fixings or serve it with homemade tortilla chips. Enjoy!
sourceNotes: The transcript describes pureeing half the beans with their liquid before adding to the pot — a technique step absent from the caption that materially affects texture; it has been added as step s01. The caption lists the cream quantity as "1/4–1/2 cup"; this range is preserved as-is rather than averaged. Built from the caption and the voiceover together -- check amounts before cooking.
